sloka: आर्तस्वनं च स्वनतां सिंहनादं च नर्दताम् ।बभूव तुमुलः शब्दो हरीणां रक्षसां युधि ।। ६.५८.१७ ।।।।
transliteration: ārtasvanaṁ ca svanatāṁ siṁhanādaṁ ca nardatām ।babhūva tumulaḥ śabdo harīṇāṁ rakṣasāṁ yudhi ।। 6.58.17 ।।।।

translations.english: Tumultuous noise like the roar of lions arose in the battlefield with Vanaras and Rakshasas cries of pain.
